newsitem.title: USA: Indiana approves NIPSCO electric rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Indiana approves NIPSCO electric rate hike.

text.p: Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission said Wednesday it approved an electric rate hike requested by Northern Indiana Public Service Co (NIPSCO) to cover fuel costs to be incurred from August to October 1997.
The commission said the utility, a subsidiary of NIPSCO Industries, could collect about 0.6 cent more a kilowatt-hour from its customers over the three-month period.

NIPSCO's request is part a regulatory procedure that allows the Indiana's electric utilities to raise or lower rates for a three-month period based upon changes in the price of fuel used to generate electricity.
NIPSCO serves about 385,000 customers in northern Indiana.
